title: 3D #1: r = cos θ î + sin θ ĵ + k̂ sweeps a cone, always 45° to z → NDA 2026 (II) Q68 (31.5 s, first Remotion 3D reel)

captions.instagram:
NDA 2026 (II) · Maths · Q68. θ keeps changing. Does the angle? 🌀

r = (cos θ) î + (sin θ) ĵ + k̂ always goes up 1 and across 1 (cos²θ + sin²θ = 1). So every r is the long side of the same right triangle: |r| = √2, cos γ = 1/√2, γ = 45° = π/4 for every θ → (c).
As θ runs, r sweeps a cone around the z-axis.
Traps: (a) π/2 is the angle of its shadow on the floor. (b) π/3 comes from cos γ = 1/2: you forgot the √ in |r|.
